What We Do

Our Services

From high-voltage installation and cable laying to motor rewinding and process instrumentation — ELECO has delivered full-service electrical contracting across Bahrain's industrial sector since 1972.

Power Distribution Cable Works Testing & Commissioning Motor & Generator Repair Control Systems Industrial & Civil Workshop Facilities
Category 01

Power Distribution & HV Works

Engineers authorised by the Ministry of Electricity & Water for High Voltage switching of Private HV Consumers' switch-gears — a credential held by very few contractors in Bahrain.

  • HV & LV Power Distribution Systems
  • High Voltage installation works
  • Earthing systems
  • Cathodic protection systems
Category 02

Cable Laying & Termination

From single cable runs to large-scale multi-circuit industrial installations, our teams handle all aspects of cable infrastructure — designed, installed, and terminated to specification.

  • HV & LV cable laying and jointing
  • Cable end straight-through terminations
  • All types of cable support systems
  • Cable laying with concrete encasement
Category 03

Testing & Commissioning

Comprehensive electrical testing and diagnostic services for panel boards, transformers, and rotating machines — including on-site oil filtration and fault rectification for heavy rotating equipment.

  • Testing and commissioning of panel boards and transformers
  • Electrical & mechanical plant maintenance
  • Diagnostic testing for insulation evaluation
  • Transformer oil filtration at site and oil testing
  • Dynamic balancing & vibration analysis
  • Fault rectification up to 6MW / 11KV
Category 04

Motor & Generator Repair

Our purpose-built workshop is authorised by Crompton Greaves and WEG as a service centre — handling LT to HT up to 11KV / 6MW (6000HP) across horizontal foot-mounted and vertical flange-mounted configurations.

  • Repairing and rewinding of HT/LT, AC/DC motors and alternators
  • Transformers and generators repair
  • AC induction motors and slip ring motors
  • Submersible pumps and synchronous motors
  • Capacity up to 5000 KW
  • Motor spares — Crompton Greaves & WEG authorised
Category 05

Control Systems & Instrumentation

Including hazardous area classifications for oil and gas, and offshore applications — where correct specification and installation is a safety-critical requirement.

  • Motor Control Centers (MCC)
  • Power Control Centers & Control Panels
  • Process and plant instrumentation systems
  • Hazardous area classifications (Oil & Gas)
  • Offshore electrical & instrumentation systems
Category 06

Industrial & Civil Works

Supporting both industrial facilities and civil infrastructure — from procurement and supply through to installation and maintenance.

  • Electrical procurement and supply
  • Indoor and outdoor lighting
  • Erection and maintenance of street lighting
  • Power factor correction
  • Heating equipment and rectifiers
  • All types of industrial electrical works
Workshop Facilities

Purpose-built for heavy electrical repair

Our South Alba Industrial Area workshop — established 1994 — is one of the largest electrical repair facilities in the Kingdom of Bahrain.

  • 20-ton overhead crane facility for heavy rotating equipment handling
  • Vacuum Pressure Impregnation (VPI) plant for insulation treatment
  • In-house machining — full machining capability without subcontracting
  • Extensive test facilities for comprehensive load and performance testing
  • Crompton Greaves & WEG partnerships — motors and spares of any capacity
